parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_session (
    session_id,
    current_usecase_id
)
VALUES ($1, $2)
ON CONFLICT (session_id)
DO UPDATE
SET
    current_usecase_id =
        EXCLUDED.current_usecase_id,
    updated_at =
        now()
RETURNING
    session_id,
    current_usecase_id,
    conversation_history,
    active_workflow;

UPDATE agent_session
SET conversation_history = conversation_history || $2::jsonb,
    updated_at           = now()
WHERE session_id = $1;
